decision: Six sequential phases, documentation-only, single deliverable file (specs/ROADMAP.md). Phase 1 is measurement-only and produces reports/02_execution-time-measurements.md, a command-cited record every later phase writes from; Phase 6 audits every numeral in ROADMAP.md back against that record, so any figure copied from the plan or research report instead of measured is a detectable failure. Phases 2-5 correct Section A (sorry census plus methodology note explaining the suppression-site undercount, and all Section A rows), the Completed section's falsified claims (decidability instance count and file attribution, CS5, temporal tableau), Section B (stale rows moved to Completed, LoopChecking figure, Blocking.lean '(new)' tag, BXCanonical count) plus creation of a task to hold the BXCanonical/dense-vs-algebraic decision, and Section C plus four new stream sections (Modal Tableau Decidability, CS5, temporal tableau, propositional upstream) folding in the roadmap-absent open tasks. The BXCanonical decision is tracked, never decided autonomously.
next_steps: Run /implement 596. The implementer must treat every figure in the plan and the research report as a hypothesis and re-measure it at execution time using the commands embedded in each phase; Phase 1 must complete before any ROADMAP.md edit. Edits must be anchored by section heading and row text, never by the line numbers cited in the plan or report, since each phase shifts subsequent lines. No .lean file may be edited, and README.md is out of file_scope (stale figures there are flagged in the summary, not fixed).
